sn35.232:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca sārīputto āyasmā ca mahākoṭṭhiko bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti isipatane migadāye.
sn35.232:1.2: atha kho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhiko sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā sārīputto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sārīputtena saddhiṃ sammodi
sn35.232:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhiko āyasmantaṃ sārīputtaṃ etadavoca
sn35.232:2.1: kiṃ nu kho āvuso sārīputta cakkhu rūpānaṃ saññojanaṃ rūpā cakkhussa saññojanaṃ …pe…
sn35.232:2.2: jivhā rasānaṃ saññojanaṃ rasā jivhāya saññojanaṃ …pe…
sn35.232:2.3: mano dhammānaṃ saññojanaṃ dhammā manassa saññojananti.
sn35.232:3.1: na kho āvuso koṭṭhika cakkhu rūpānaṃ saññojanaṃ na rūpā cakkhussa saññojanaṃ
sn35.232:3.2: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ.
sn35.232:3.3: na jivhā rasānaṃ saññojanaṃ na rasā jivhāya saññojanaṃ
sn35.232:3.4: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ. …pe…
sn35.232:3.5: na mano dhammānaṃ saññojanaṃ na dhammā manassa saññojanaṃ
sn35.232:3.6: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ.
sn35.232:4.1: seyyathāpi āvuso kāḷo ca balibaddo odāto ca balibaddo ekena dāmena vā yottena vā saṃyuttā assu
sn35.232:4.3: kāḷo balibaddo odātassa balibaddassa saññojanaṃ odāto balibaddo kāḷassa balibaddassa saññojananti sammā nu kho so vadamāno vadeyyāti.
sn35.232:4.5: na kho āvuso kāḷo balibaddo odātassa balibaddassa saññojanaṃ napi odāto balibaddo kāḷassa balibaddassa saññojanaṃ
sn35.232:4.6: yena ca kho te ekena dāmena vā yottena vā saṃyuttā taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ.
sn35.232:5.1: evameva kho āvuso na cakkhu rūpānaṃ saññojanaṃ na rūpā cakkhussa saññojanaṃ
sn35.232:5.2: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ …pe…
sn35.232:5.4: na mano dhammānaṃ saññojanaṃ na dhammā manassa saññojanaṃ
sn35.232:5.5: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ.
sn35.232:6.1: cakkhu vā āvuso rūpānaṃ saññojanaṃ abhavissa rūpā vā cakkhussa saññojanaṃ na yidaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammādukkhakkhayāya
sn35.232:6.2: yasmā ca kho āvuso na cakkhu rūpānaṃ saññojanaṃ na rūpā cakkhussa saññojanaṃ
sn35.232:6.3: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ tasmā brahmacariyavāso paññāyati sammādukkhakkhayāya …pe…
sn35.232:7.1: jivhā vā āvuso rasānaṃ saññojanaṃ abhavissa rasā vā jivhāya saññojanaṃ nayidaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammādukkhakkhayāya
sn35.232:7.2: yasmā ca kho āvuso na jivhā rasānaṃ saññojanaṃ na rasā jivhāya saññojanaṃ yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ tasmā brahmacariyavāso paññāyati sammādukkhakkhayāya …pe…
sn35.232:8.1: mano vā āvuso dhammānaṃ saññojanaṃ abhavissa dhammā vā manassa saññojanaṃ nayidaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammādukkhakkhayāya
sn35.232:8.2: yasmā ca kho āvuso na mano dhammānaṃ saññojanaṃ na dhammā manassa saññojanaṃ
sn35.232:8.3: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ tasmā brahmacariyavāso paññāyati sammādukkhakkhayāya.
sn35.232:9.1: imināpetaṃ āvuso pariyāyena veditabbaṃ. yathā na cakkhu rūpānaṃ saññojanaṃ na rūpā cakkhussa saññojanaṃ
sn35.232:9.2: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ …pe…
sn35.232:9.4: na mano dhammānaṃ saññojanaṃ na dhammā manassa saññojanaṃ.
sn35.232:9.5: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ.
sn35.232:11.1: iminā kho etaṃ āvuso pariyāyena veditabbaṃ. yathā na cakkhu rūpānaṃ saññojanaṃ na rūpā cakkhussa saññojanaṃ
sn35.232:11.2: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ.
sn35.232:11.5: na jivhā rasānaṃ saññojanaṃ na rasā jivhāya saññojanaṃ
sn35.232:11.6: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ.
sn35.232:11.8: na mano dhammaṃ saññojanaṃ na dhammā manassa saññojanaṃ
sn35.232:11.9: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojananti.
